---@return Direction
function vector_util.to_side_dir(v)
  if v.x < 0 then
    return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
  else
    return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
  end
end

---벡터 v에서 x 성분에 특정 값을 대입한 새로운 벡터를 리턴하는 함수
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@param x nil|number default: 0
---@return Vector3
function vector_util.get_0yz(v, x)
  x = lua_helper.get_or_default(x, 0)

  if v.z ~= nil then
    return unity_class.vector3(x, v.y, v.z)
  else
    return unity_class.vector3(x, v.x, v.y)
  end
end

---벡터 v에서 y 성분에 특정 값을 대입한 새로운 벡터를 리턴하는 함수
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@param y nil|number default: 0
---@return Vector3
function vector_util.get_x0z(v, y)
  y = lua_helper.get_or_default(y, 0)

  if v.z ~= nil then
    return unity_class.vector3(v.x, y, v.z)
  else
    return unity_class.vector3(v.x, y, v.y)
  end
end

---벡터 v에서 z 성분에 특정 값을 대입한 새로운 벡터를 리턴하는 함수
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@param z nil|number default: 0
---@return Vector3
function vector_util.get_xy0(v, z)
  z = lua_helper.get_or_default(z, 0)

  if v.z ~= nil then
    return unity_class.vector3(v.x, v.y, z)
  else
    return unity_class.vector3(v.x, v.y, z)
  end
end

---두 벡터의 거리의 제곱을 리턴
---@param a Vector3
---@param b Vector3
---@return number
function vector_util.sqr_distance(a, b)
  local ab = b - a
  return ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y + ab.z * ab.z
end

---두 벡터의 xz 평면에서 거리의 제곱을 리턴
---@param a Vector3
---@param b Vector3
---@return number
function vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(a, b)
  local ab = b - a
  return ab.x * ab.x + ab.z * ab.z
end

---기준점에서 특정 반지름을 갖는 원 안의 랜덤한 위치를 리턴
---@param center Vector3 기준점
---@param radius number|nil 반지름
---@return Vector3
function vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(center, radius)
  radius = lua_helper.get_or_default(radius, 1)

  local rad = 360 * unity_class.random.value * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad
  local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * unity_class.mathf.Cos(rad) * radius
  local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * unity_class.mathf.Sin(rad) * radius
  return center + x_offset + z_offset
end

---벡터의 크기의 제곱이 사실상 0에 근접하는지 리턴
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@return boolean
function vector_util.is_almost_zero(v)
  return v.sqrMagnitude < constants.epsilon
end

---두 벡터의 차의 제곱이 사실상 0에 근접하는지 리턴
---@param a Vector3|Vector2
---@param b Vector3|Vector2
---@return boolean
function vector_util.almost_close_to(a, b)
  return (a - b).sqrMagnitude < constants.epsilon
end

---벡터의 크기 리턴
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@return number
function vector_util.magnitude(v)
  return v.magnitude
end

---벡터 정규화한 단위벡터 리턴
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@return Vector3|Vector2
function vector_util.normalized(v)
  return v.normalized
end

---두 벡터의 거리 리턴
---@param a Vector3|Vector2
---@param b Vector3|Vector2
---@return number
function vector_util.distance(a, b)
  local ab = b - a
  return math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y + ab.z * ab.z)
end

---두 벡터를 선형보간한 벡터 리턴
---@param a Vector3
---@param b Vector3
---@param p number
function vector_util.lerp(a, b, p)
  return CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(a, b, p)
end

---길이가 절반인 벡터 리턴
---@param v Vector3|Vector2
---@return Vector3|Vector2
function vector_util.half(v)
  return v * 0.5
end

---두 벡터의 내적
---theta 값 반환
---@param lhs Vector3
---@param rhs Vector3
---@return number
function vector_util.dot(lhs, rhs)
  return lhs.x * rhs.x + lhs.y * rhs.y + lhs.z * rhs.z
end

function vector_util.move_towards(current, target, max_distance_delta)
  local num1 = target.x - current.x;
  local num2 = target.y - current.y;
  local num3 = target.z - current.z;
  local d = num1 * num1 + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3;
  if (d == 0.0 or max_distance_delta >= 0.0 and d <= max_distance_delta * max_distance_delta) then
    return target;
  end

  local num4 = math.sqrt(d);
  return CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(current.x + num1 / num4 * max_distance_delta, current.y + num2 / num4 * max_distance_delta, current.z + num3 / num4 * max_distance_delta);
end

function vector_util.quadratic_bezier(p0, p1, p2, t)
  local m0 = vector_util.lerp(p0, p1, t)
  local m1 = vector_util.lerp(p1, p2, t)

  return vector_util.lerp(m0, m1, t)
end

return {
  create = function()
    return vector_util
  end
}

require('base/class')
util = require('xlua/util')

function init()
	coroutine_manager = CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance
	game_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject
	unity_object_pool = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPool
	message_system = CS.Oak.LuaMessageSystemAdapter.GetOrCreate(CS.Oak.LuaMessageSystemLifeCycle.StageOnly)
	music_player = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance
	user = CS.Oak.User.Me
	user_progress = CS.Oak.UserProgress.Instance
	game_data_service = CS.Oak.GameDataService

	event_delegate = CS.EventDelegate
	event_story_world_utils = CS.Oak.UI.EventStoryWorldMapUtils
	world_map_background_utils = CS.Oak.WorldMapBackgroundUtils
	-- obsolete 직접 호출 하면 안됨
	ui_sceneManager = CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance

	float_util = require('base/float_util')
	world_map_util = require('utils/WorldMapCommonUtil')

	unity_class = {
		list = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List,
		queue = CS.System.Collections.Generic.Queue,
		dictionary = CS.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary,
		mathf = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf,
		quaternion = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion,
		vector2 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2,
		vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3,
		vector4 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector4,
		time = CS.UnityEngine.Time,
		color = CS.UnityEngine.Color,
		random = CS.UnityEngine.Random
	}

	get_ui_scene_manager = function()
		if ui_sceneManager == nil or ui_sceneManager.CurrentScene == nil then
			ui_sceneManager = CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance
		end

		return ui_sceneManager
	end

	-- coroutine 클래스 캐싱
	coroutine_class = {
		coroutine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine,
		wait_for_sec =  function(time)
			local s = unity_class.time.time
			while unity_class.time.time - s < time do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end,
		wait_for_unscaled_sec = function(time)
			local s = unity_class.time.unscaledTime
			while unity_class.time.unscaledTime - s < time do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end,
		wait_all = CS.Foundations.WaitAll
	}

	unity_color = function(data)
		if data[4] == nil then
			return unity_class.color(data[1], data[2], data[3])
		else
			return unity_class.color(data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4])
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec = function(delay)
		local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
		while CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s < delay do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 기존 CS.Foundations.WaitAll의 경우 Param이 1개일 때 문제가 생겨(루아 오류인듯...?)
	-- Param이 1개 일 때 예외 처리함
	wait_all = function(...)
		local params = {}
		if type_util.is_table(...) then
			params = ...
		else
			params = table.pack(...)
		end

		local count = #params
		if count == 1 then
			-- cs_generator 또는 coroutine이 넘어올 수 있기 때문에 체크
			local co
			if CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CheckType(params[1], typeof(CS.Foundations.Coroutine)) then
				co = params[1]
			else
				co = coroutine_class.coroutine(params[1])
			end
			-- HACK: 우리 코루틴은 던지면 바로 실행 시켜야 되므로 여기서 실행
			-- 바로 한번 실행
			local co = coroutine_class.coroutine(params[1])

			-- co:MoveNext()
			coroutine.yield(co)
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(params)))
	end

	function try(f, catch_f)
		local status, exception = pcall(f)
		if not status then
			catch_f(exception)
		end
	end

	yield_return_func = function(func, ...)
		local args = {...}

		try(function ()
			coroutine.yield(func(table.unpack(args)))
		end, function(e)
			exception_stage_exit(e)
		end)
	end

	is_unity_null = function(fo)
		--- nil(정의 되지 않음)
		if fo == nil then
			return true
		end

		--- Null
		if fo:Equals(nil) then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	string_helper = {
		start_with = function(str, start)
			return str:sub(1, #start) == start
		end,
		ends_with = function(str, ending)
			return ending == "" or str:sub(-#ending) == ending
		end,
		is_nil_or_empty = function(str)
			return str == nil or str == ''
		end
	}

	-- vector 생성, 인자 수에 따라 가능
	vector = function(x, y, z, w)
		if z == nil then
			return unity_class.vector2(x, y)
		end

		if w == nil then
			return unity_class.vector3(x, y, z)
		end

		return unity_class.vector4(x, y, z, w)
	end

	type_util = {
		is_table = function(table)
			return table ~= nil and type(table) == 'table'
		end,
		is_array = function(table)
			return table ~= nil and type(table) == 'table' and table[1] ~= nil
		end,
		is_number = function(data)
			return data ~= nil and type(data) == 'number'
		end,
		is_string = function(data)
			return data ~= nil and type(data) == 'string'
		end,
		is_character = function(data)
			return data['character'] ~= nil
		end,
		is_function = function(data)
			return data ~= nil and type(data) == 'function'
		end,
	}

	table_util = {
		contain_value = function(t, v)
			if t== nil or v == nil then return false end

			if type_util.is_array(t) then
				for _, compare in ipairs(t) do
					if v == compare then
						return true
					end
				end
			else
				for _, compare in pairs(t) do
					if v == compare then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		get_size = function(table)
			if type_util.is_array(table) then
				return #table
			else
				local count = 0
				for _, _ in pairs(table) do
					count = count + 1
				end

				return count
			end
		end,
		contain_key = function(t, k)
			if t == nil or k== nil then return false end

			for comp, _ in pairs(t) do
				if k == comp then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		for_each = function(t, func)
			if t == nil or func == nil then return end

			for k, v in pairs(t) do
				func(k, v)
			end
		end,
		duplicate = function(t)
			if t == nil then return end

			local ret = {}
			table_util.for_each(t, function (k, v) ret[k] = v  end)

			return ret
		end
	}

	lua_helper = {
		get_conditional_value = function(conditional, v1, v2)
			if conditional then
				return v1
			else
				return v2
			end
		end
	}

	create_generic_dictionary = function(type1, type2)
		local dic_type = unity_class.dictionary(type1, type2)
		return dic_type()
	end
end

function finish()
	coroutine_manager = nil
	unity_object_pool = nil
	message_system = nil
	music_player = nil
	user_progress = nil
	game_data_service = nil
	game_string = nil
	ui_sceneManager = nil
	unity_class = nil
	unity_color = nil
	coroutine_class = nil
	wait_for_sec = nil
	wait_all = nil
	yield_return_func = nil
	is_unity_null = nil
	string_helper = nil
	vector = nil
	type_util = nil
	table_util = nil
	float_util = nil
	world_map_util = nil
	lua_helper = nil
	create_generic_dictionary = nil
end

wp_util = {}

---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move_async 사용할 것
function wp_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, waypoints, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx, animtimescale)
	local waypoint_count = 0
	if waypoints.Count == nil then
		if type_util.is_array(waypoints) then
			for _, _ in ipairs(waypoints) do
				waypoint_count = waypoint_count + 1
			end
		else
			waypoint_count = 1
		end
	else
		waypoint_count = waypoints.Count
	end

	local move_end = false
	local cb = function(waypoint_index)
		move_end = waypoint_count == waypoint_index + 1
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(fo, waypoints, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx, animtimescale, cb)

	while (not move_end and fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move 사용할 것
function wp_util.move_waypoint(fo, waypointlist, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx, animtimescale, callback)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(character_util.get_direction(lastdirection), CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	local sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(playsfx, false)
	local anitime = lua_helper.get_or_default(animtimescale, 0)

	local wp, end_type, y_mode

	if waypointlist.Count == nil then
		wp = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if type_util.is_array(waypointlist) then
			for _, point in ipairs(waypointlist) do
				wp:Add(point)
			end
		else
			wp:Add(waypointlist)
		end
	else
		wp = waypointlist
	end

	if type_util.is_string(endtype) then
		if endtype == "stop" then
			end_type = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
		elseif endtype == "loop" then
			end_type = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Loop
		end
	else
		end_type = endtype
	end

	if type_util.is_string(ymode) then
		if ymode == "free" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
		elseif ymode == "floor" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Floor
		elseif ymode == "flying" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
		end
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()
	move_info.waypoints = wp
	move_info.speed = speed
	move_info.lastDirection = dir or CS.Oak.Direction.None
	move_info.endType = end_type or CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
	move_info.yMode = y_mode or CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
	move_info.run = run
	move_info.playSfx = sfx
	move_info.animTimeScale = anitime
	move_info.callback = callback

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, move_info)
end

function wp_util.create_info_with_table(data)
	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()

	info.lastDirection = lua_helper.get_value(data, "last_direction", CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	local waypoints = lua_helper.get_value(data, "waypoints")
	local waypoint_list = nil
	if waypoints.Count == nil then
		waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if type_util.is_array(waypoints) then
			for _, point in ipairs(waypoints) do
				waypoint_list:Add(point)
			end
		else
			-- 포인트가 하나일때
			waypoint_list:Add(waypoints)
		end
	else
		-- C# List<T> 일때
		waypoint_list = waypoints
	end

	info.waypoints = waypoint_list
	info.speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, "speed")
	info.run = lua_helper.get_value(data, "run", false)
	info.playSfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, "play_sfx", false)

	local ymode = lua_helper.get_value(data, "ymode", nil)
	local y_mode = nil
	if type_util.is_string(ymode) then
		if ymode == "free" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
		elseif ymode == "floor" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Floor
		elseif ymode == "flying" then
			y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
		end
	end

	info.yMode = y_mode or CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
	info.animTimeScale = lua_helper.get_value(data, "anim_time_scale", 0)

	local end_type_val = lua_helper.get_value(data, "end_type")

	if type_util.is_string(end_type_val) then
		if end_type_val == "stop" then
			info.endType = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
		elseif end_type_val == "loop" then
			info.endType = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Loop
		end
	else
		info.endType = end_type_val or CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
	end

	info.callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, "callback")
	return info
end

---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move 사용할 것
function wp_util.move_way_points(fo, data)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end
	local info = wp_util.create_info_with_table(data)

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, info)
end

---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move_async 사용할 것
function wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo, data)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local info = wp_util.create_info_with_table(data)

	local wp_count = info.waypoints.Count
	local move_end = false
	local cb = function(waypoint_index)
		move_end = wp_count == waypoint_index + 1
	end
	info.callback = cb

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, info)

	while (not move_end) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

function wp_util.get_duration(start_pos, way_points, speed)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()
	move_info.waypoints = way_points
	move_info.speed = speed

	return move_info:GetDuration(start_pos)
end

---@class WpUtilMoveData
---@field last_direction Direction 이동이 끝난 후 캐릭터가 바라보아야 할 방향
---@field end_type string 이동이 끝났을 때 어떤 행동을 취할지를 지정하는 스트링 키 (waypoint_move_end_type)
---@field y_mode string 이동 모드. 캐릭터와 그림자가 y snaping 을 할지 등을 결정 (character_y_mode_constants)
---@field run boolean 캐릭터가 달리는 모션을 취하는지
---@field play_sfx boolean 달리는 소리 (01_dash_01) 를 재생할지
---@field callback function 각 웨이포인트에 도달했을 때 불리는 콜백
---@field locked_dir string|Direction 이동하는 동안 캐릭터가 고정적으로 바라볼 방향
---@field end_callback function 웨이포인트 이동이 끝났을 때 불리는 콜백

---캐릭터 움직이는 함수
---@param fo ICharacter 움직일 캐릭터
---@param waypoints Vector3 | Vector3[] 이동할 웨이포인트
---@param speed number 이동 속력
---@param duration number 이동 시간
---@param data nil|WpUtilMoveData 기타 이동 관련 데이터
function wp_util.move(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	if type_util.is_array(waypoints) then
		for _, point in ipairs(waypoints) do
			waypoint_list:Add(point)
		end
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(waypoints)
	end

	local move_speed = speed
	if speed == nil and duration ~= nil then
		local dist = (waypoint_list[0] - fo.Position).magnitude
		for i = 1, waypoint_list.Count - 1 do
			dist = dist + (waypoint_list[i] - waypoint_list[i - 1]).magnitude
		end

		move_speed = math.max(dist / duration, 0.1)
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()

	move_info.waypoints = waypoint_list
	move_info.speed = move_speed

	local last_direction = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'last_direction', CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	move_info.lastDirection = character_util.get_direction(last_direction)

	local end_type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_type', 'stop')
	move_info.endType = waypoint_move_end_type[end_type]

	local y_mode = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'y_mode', 'free')
	move_info.yMode = character_y_mode_constants[y_mode]

	move_info.run = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'run', false)
	move_info.playSfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'play_sfx', false)
	move_info.callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'callback')

	local locked_dir = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'locked_dir')
	local end_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_callback')

	if locked_dir then
		character_util.set_locked_dir(fo, locked_dir)

		move_info.endCallback = function()
			if last_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
				character_util.set_direction(fo, locked_dir)
			else
				character_util.set_direction(fo, last_direction)
			end

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(fo)

			if end_callback then
				end_callback()
			end
		end
	else
		move_info.endCallback = end_callback
	end

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, move_info)
end

---캐릭터 움직이는 함수 - 끝까지 기다림
---@param fo ICharacter 움직일 캐릭터
---@param waypoints Vector3 | Vector3[] 이동할 웨이포인트
---@param speed number 이동 속력
---@param duration number 이동 시간
---@param data nil|WpUtilMoveData 기타 이동 관련 데이터
function wp_util.move_async(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)
	local end_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_callback')

	if data == nil then
		data = {}
	end

	local move_end = false

	data.end_callback = function()
		if end_callback then
			end_callback()
		end

		move_end = true
	end

	wp_util.move(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)

	while not move_end and fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

---캐릭터 움직이는 함수 - 콜백을 이용하여 이동이 끝났는지 체크
---@param fo ICharacter 움직일 캐릭터
---@param waypoints Vector3 | Vector3[] 이동할 웨이포인트
---@param speed number 이동 속력
---@param duration number 이동 시간
---@param handler table handler는 특정 스트링 키로 등록된 이동들이 진행 중인지 여부를 숫자로 들고 있는 테이블을 갖게 됨.
---@param key nil|string 이동의 스트링 키
---@param data nil|WpUtilMoveData 기타 이동 관련 데이터
function wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, handler, key, data)
	local callback_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(key, 'default')
	local end_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_callback')

	if handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end == nil then
		handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end = {}
	end

	if handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] == nil then
		handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] = 0
	end

	handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] = handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] + 1

	if data == nil then
		data = {}
	end

	data.end_callback = function()
		if end_callback then
			end_callback()
		end

		handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] = handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] - 1
	end

	wp_util.move(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)
end

---특정 스트링 키로 등록된 이동들이 전부 완료될 때까지 대기하는 함수
---@param handler table handler는 특정 스트링 키로 등록된 이동들이 진행 중인지 여부를 숫자로 들고 있는 테이블을 갖게 됨
---@param key nil|string 이동의 스트링 키
function wp_util.wait_move_end(handler, key)
	local callback_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(key, 'default')

	while handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] > 0 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

---@param handler table handler는 특정 스트링 키로 등록된 이동들이 진행 중인지 여부를 숫자로 들고 있는 테이블을 갖게 됨
---@param key nil|string 이동의 스트링 키
---@return boolean 이동들이 진행 중인지 여부
function wp_util.is_moving_with_end_callback(handler, key)
	local callback_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(key, 'default')

	return handler.wp_util_remaining_move_end[callback_key] > 0
end

--- 도착 지점까지 x, z축에 평행하게 직각으로 이동하는 "ㄱ"자 움직임 Waypoint를 가져오는 함수
--- 이 함수는 항상 wp_util.move~~ 함수를 사용하는 시점, 즉 캐릭터 위치가 이미 세팅된 상태에서 불릴 것임
--- 또한 이 웨이포인트 결과물을 캐싱해서 쓰는 것은 대부분의 상황에서 최적화 등의 면에서 크게 의미가 없음
--- 따라서 첫 인자는 편의성을 위해(.Position 매번 넣지 않도록) start_pos가 아닌 움직일 캐릭터로 함
---@param character ICharacter 움직일 캐릭터
---@param end_pos Vector3 도착 지점
---@param move_side_first boolean 어떤 방향으로 먼저 움직일 것인지
---								우측 하단으로 이동하는 경우, 오른쪽으로 먼저 이동하고 아래로 내려가면 true
---								아래로 먼저 내려가고 오른쪽으로 이동하면 false
---@return table<Vector3> Waypoint(Vector3) 테이블
function wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(character, end_pos, move_side_first)
	local start_pos = character.Position

	if move_side_first then
		return {
			vector_util.get_xy0(end_pos, start_pos.z),
			end_pos
		}
	else
		return {
			vector_util.get_0yz(end_pos, start_pos.x),
			end_pos
		}
	end
end

--- 도착 지점까지 x, z축에 평행하게 직각으로 이동하는 "Z" 혹은 "ㄷ"자 (두 번 꺾는) 움직임 Waypoint를 가져오는 함수
--- 이 함수는 항상 wp_util.move~~ 함수를 사용하는 시점, 즉 캐릭터 위치가 이미 세팅된 상태에서 불릴 것임
--- 또한 이 웨이포인트 결과물을 캐싱해서 쓰는 것은 대부분의 상황에서 최적화 등의 면에서 크게 의미가 없음
--- 따라서 첫 인자는 편의성을 위해(.Position 매번 넣지 않도록) start_pos가 아닌 움직일 캐릭터로 함
---@param character ICharacter 움직일 캐릭터
---@param end_pos Vector3 도착 지점
---@param xz_data table 중간에 두 번 꺾는 지점 사이에 고정되는 x 혹은 z 값
---						해당 인자는 항상 { x = (number)XXX } 혹은 { z = (number)ZZZ }으로 구성되어야 함 (주의!!! 벡터 아님)
---						x를 세팅하면 좌우 이동으로, z를 세팅하면 상하 이동으로 시작함
---@return table<Vector3> Waypoint(Vector3) 테이블
function wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(character, end_pos, xz_data)
	local start_pos = character.Position

	if xz_data.x then
		return {
			vector_util.get_0yz(start_pos, xz_data.x),
			vector_util.get_0yz(end_pos, xz_data.x),
			end_pos
		}
	else
		return {
			vector_util.get_xy0(start_pos, xz_data.z),
			vector_util.get_xy0(end_pos, xz_data.z),
			end_pos
		}
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return wp_util
	end
}

zone_util = {}

--- 특정 존에 들어갔을 때 되돌아가는 연출 시, 되돌아갈 지점을 계산해줌
---@param zone Zone|string 존 인스턴스 혹은 존 이름
---@param fo IFieldObject 되돌아갈 캐릭터
---@param entered_dir string 입장(혹은 퇴장할) 방향. up/down/left/right 중 하나
---@param xz_adder nil|number 타겟 위치에 도달했을 때 ZoneBounds와 FoBounds 사이에 얼마나 간격을 둘 지
---@return Vector3 되돌아갈 지점
function zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, fo, entered_dir, xz_adder)
	if type_util.is_string(zone) then
		zone = field_util.get_zone(zone)
	end

	xz_adder = lua_helper.get_or_default(xz_adder, 0.3)

	-- 음수 등이 들어가서 비정상 동작하는 것을 막기 위함
	-- 최솟값을 epsilon으로 한 것은 0으로 하면 Enter가 다시 불리지 않는 경우가 있기 때문
	xz_adder = math.max(xz_adder, constants.epsilon)

	local target_pos = fo.Position

	-- 입장한 방향 기준으로 위치 계산
	-- 입장한 방향을 유틸 내에서 판단하기는 어려우므로 인자로 입력받음
	-- 저프레임 환경에서의 배틀액션 등으로 한 프레임에 여러 칸을 가는 경우가 있기 때문
	if entered_dir == 'left' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(fo.Position, zone.Bounds.min.x - (fo.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder))
	elseif entered_dir == 'right' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(fo.Position, zone.Bounds.max.x + (fo.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder))
	elseif entered_dir == 'down' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Position, zone.Bounds.min.z - (fo.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder))
	elseif entered_dir == 'up' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Position, zone.Bounds.max.z + (fo.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder))
	end

	return target_pos
end

--- 특정 존에서 나갔을 때 되돌아가는 연출 시, 되돌아갈 지점을 계산해줌
--- !!! 주의 !!! 존 크기가 너무 작거나 [xz_adder]가 존의 크기에 비해 너무 큰 경우는 일반적이지 않으므로 산정하지 않았음!
---@param zone Zone|string 존 인스턴스 혹은 존 이름
---@param fo IFieldObject 되돌아갈 캐릭터
---@param xz_adder nil|number 타겟 위치에 도달했을 때 ZoneBounds와 FoBounds 사이에 얼마나 간격을 둘 지
---@return Vector3 되돌아갈 지점
function zone_util.get_return_pos_on_leave(zone, fo, xz_adder)
	if type_util.is_string(zone) then
		zone = field_util.get_zone(zone)
	end

	xz_adder = lua_helper.get_or_default(xz_adder, 0.3)

	-- 음수 등이 들어가서 비정상 동작하는 것을 막기 위함
	-- 최솟값을 epsilon으로 한 것은 0으로 하면 Leave가 다시 불리지 않는 경우가 있기 때문
	xz_adder = math.max(xz_adder, constants.epsilon)

	local target_pos = fo.Position

	-- enter_comback_pos와는 다르게, 한 프레임에 여러 칸을 가더라도 존을 퇴장했다는 사실은 동일함
	-- 따라서 퇴장 방향에 대한 계산은 필요하지 않으므로, 방향 정보를 인자로 받지 않아도 됨

	if fo.Bounds.min.x < zone.Bounds.min.x + xz_adder then
		target_pos.x = zone.Bounds.min.x + (fo.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder)
	elseif fo.Bounds.max.x > zone.Bounds.max.x - xz_adder then
		target_pos.x = zone.Bounds.max.x - (fo.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder)
	end

	if fo.Bounds.min.z < zone.Bounds.min.z + xz_adder then
		target_pos.z = zone.Bounds.min.z + (fo.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder)
	elseif fo.Bounds.max.z > zone.Bounds.max.z - xz_adder then
		target_pos.z = zone.Bounds.max.z - (fo.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder)
	end

	return target_pos
end

-- fo가 zone에 포함되어 있는지 체크해줌
---@param zone Zone|string 존 인스턴스 혹은 존 이름
---@param fo IFieldObject 체크할 캐릭터 캐릭터
---@param full_entered nil|boolean 캐릭터가 존에 모두 들어간 경우에만 true 반환할 것인지
---@return boolean 포함되어 있는지 여부
function zone_util.contains_fo(zone, fo, full_entered)
	if type_util.is_string(zone) then
		zone = field_util.get_zone(zone)
	end

	full_entered = lua_helper.get_or_default(full_entered, true)

	if full_entered then
		return zone.ContainsFieldObjects:Contains(fo)
	else
		return zone.IntersectsFieldObjects:Contains(fo)
	end
end

--- Zone 또는 Zone 이름에 해당하는 Zone의 랜덤 위치 값을 반환
--- @param zone Zone|string 존 인스턴스 혹은 존 이름
--- @param data { border_x:number, border_z:number } border_x: 제외 범위 지정, border_z: 제외 범위 지정
--- @return Vector3 pos 값
function zone_util.get_random_pos(zone, data)
	if type_util.is_string(zone) then
		zone = field_util.get_zone(zone)
	end

	-- zone.Bounds 데이터 캐싱
	local bounds = zone.Bounds

	-- 제외 범위 설정
	local border_x = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'border_x', 0.0)
	local border_z = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'border_z', 0.0)

	-- min, max 값 설정
	local min = { x = bounds.min.x + border_x, z = bounds.min.z + border_z }
	local max = { x = bounds.max.x - border_x, z = bounds.max.z - border_z }

	-- border값을 더한 min max의 값을 에 대한 비교  (border 값 역전 확인)
	if min.x > max.x or min.z > max.z then
		return nil
	end

	local pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	-- 계산된 min, max의 랜덤 값을 추출
	pos.x = unity_class.random.Range(min.x, max.x)
	pos.z = unity_class.random.Range(min.z, max.z)

	return pos
end

return {
	create = function()
		return zone_util
	end
}

	end

	local students = self.aerobics_students
	local exercise_data = self.aerobics_exercise_data
	local idx = 1

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	self.exercise_music = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_amb_cf_03', loop = true })

	while true do
		local cur_dir = exercise_data[idx].dir
		local cur_anim = exercise_data[idx].anim
		local cur_repeat_time = exercise_data[idx].repeat_time
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local student = students[i]
			character_util.set_direction(student, cur_dir)
			character_util.set_anim(student, { name = cur_anim, loop = true })
		end

		-- 매 프레임 탈출 조건 확인
		local anim_dur = spine_util.get_animation_duration(students[1], cur_anim) * cur_repeat_time
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < anim_dur do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if not self.is_player_in_aerobics_room then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if not self.is_player_in_aerobics_room then
			character_util.remove_group_anim(students)
			break
		end

		idx = idx + 1 > table_util.get_size(exercise_data) and 1 or idx + 1
	end

function local_class:laura_you_will_float_too()
    local laura = get_character('laura')

    local deg = 0
    local start_y = 0
    local move_y = 0.3
    local duration = 1.25
    local laura_init_pos = field:GetMarker('laura_chained').position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

    local dir = 1

    while self.keep_laura_floating do
        if deg >= 90 then
            dir = -1
        elseif deg < 0 then
            dir = 1
        end

        deg = deg + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 90 / duration * dir

        local cur_y = start_y + move_y * math.sin(deg * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
        laura.Position = vector(laura.Position.x, cur_y + 1.5, laura.Position.z)
        laura.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = laura_init_pos
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

		end

		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self.island_light.Transform:Find('glow').gameObject:SetActive(false)

			self.star_piece_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.star_piece_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.island_light.Position + vector(0, 2, 0))
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
			self:set_dancer_scared()
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 then
				self:set_emotion_spine_controller(self.seller, 'smile')
			end

			self.island_radio.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		else
			self:set_emotion_spine_controller(self.seller, 'tired')
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 then
			self.buy_item_flags[3] = true
		end

		self.drop_item_seller_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self.drop_item_seller_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = self.island_sell_item_list[0].Position + vector(0, 1, 0.2),
					  itemid = self.maneater_item_id, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,
					  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1 }))

			self.island_sell_item_list[0].Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		else
			self.drop_item_seller_list:Add(nil)
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 then
			self.drop_item_seller_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = self.island_sell_item_list[1].Position + vector(0, 1, 0),
					  itemid = self.light_battery_item_id, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,

					  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1 })

			self.drop_item_radio.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)

			self.island_radio.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		else

				self.give_radio = true

		end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.dance_sfx == nil then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.dance_zone then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 2 then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				self.dance_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_amb_cf_04", loop = true })
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.sell_zone then
			if self.give_radio then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				self.dance_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_amb_cf_04", loop = true })
			end
		end
	end

	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.dance_sfx ~= nil then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.dance_zone then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 2 then
				self.dance_sfx:FadeOut()
				self.dance_sfx = nil

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.sell_zone then

				self.dance_sfx:FadeOut()

function local_class:show_speech_bubble_spine_controller(target, string_key, shout, world_pos, skip)
	local is_shout = lua_helper.get_or_default(shout, false)
	local world_pos_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(world_pos, nil)
	local is_skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true)

	param = speech_bubble.generate_param(get_party_leader(), game_string:GetString(string_key))
	param.Speaker = target.Transform
	param.ClickToProceed = is_skip

	end

end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러의 애니메이션 실행
function local_class:set_animation_spine_controller(target, args)
	local anim_name = args.name
	local loop = lua_helper.get_value(args, "loop", true)
	local upper = lua_helper.get_value(args, "upper", false)
	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(args, "scale", 1)
	local mix_duration = lua_helper.get_value(args, "mix_duration", nil)
	local sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(args, "sfx_name", nil)
	local sfx_key = lua_helper.get_value(args, "sfx_key", nil)
	local next_anim = lua_helper.get_value(args, "next_anim", nil)

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	if upper then
		spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Upper)
	end

	local sfx_handler = CS.Oak.LuaScriptOperationHelper.KeyframeSoundPlayDelegate(
			target.Transform.localPosition, sfx_key, sfx_name)

	target:ClearTrack(spine_track)
	target:SetAnimation(spine_track, anim_name, loop, scale, mix_duration, sfx_handler, next_anim)
end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러의 이모션 실행
function local_class:set_emotion_spine_controller(target, name, loop)
	local is_loop = lua_helper.get_or_default(loop, true)
	target:SetEmotion(name, is_loop)
end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러 애니메이션 제거
function local_class:remove_animation_spine_controller(target, upper)
	local is_upper = lua_helper.get_or_default(upper, false)

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	if is_upper then
		spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Upper)
	end

	target:ClearTrack(spine_track)
	target:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'idle', true)
end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러 이모션 제거
function local_class:remove_emotion_spine_controller(target)
	target:SetEmotion('idle', true)
end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러가 다른 대상 바라봄
function local_class:look_at_spine_controller(looker, target)
	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(target.Transform.localPosition - looker.Transform.localPosition)
	looker.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and looker.Direction or look_dir
end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러 이동
function local_class:move_to_spine_controller(
		target, pos, speed, duration, auto_dir, auto_anim_start, auto_anim_end, last_dir)
	local timer = 0
	local start_pos = target.Transform.localPosition
	local dist = pos - start_pos

	local move_duration

	if speed ~= nil then
		move_duration = dist.magnitude / speed
	else
		move_duration = duration
	end

	if auto_dir then
		target.Direction = dist:ToDirection()
	end

	if auto_anim_start then
		self:set_animation_spine_controller(target, { name = 'walk' })
	end

	while timer < move_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos, timer / move_duration)

		target.Transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if auto_anim_end then
		self:remove_animation_spine_controller(target)
	end

	if last_dir ~= nil then
		target.Direction = last_dir
	end
end
--endregion

-- DropItem 강제 이동
function local_class:move_drop_item(drop_item, target_Pos, duration)
	timer = 0

	start_pos = drop_item.Position
	end_pos = target_Pos

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)
		local cur_y = (duration * timer - timer * timer) * 12

		drop_item:SetPosition(cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0))

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.3)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(drop_item.Position)

	drop_item.Position = end_pos
end

function local_class:light_loop()
	local timer = 0
	local wait_duration = 3

	while self.is_light_loop do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= wait_duration then
			timer = 0

			wait_for_light = true

			if self.light_on then
				self.light_on = false
			else
				self.light_on = true
			end

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(

			character_util.set_anim(self.light_manager, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_light, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

-- 반딧불 Sorting Order 설정
function local_class:set_firefly_order()
	local timer = 0
	local count = 1
	local firefly_set_order_duration = 1
	local firefly_order = 0

	character_util.set_anim(self.firefly, { name = 'spin' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	while self.firefly ~= nil do
		if self.is_firefly_set_sorting_order then
			if timer == 0 then
				character_util.set_anim(self.firefly, { name = 'spin' })
			end

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if timer >= firefly_set_order_duration * count then
				count = count + 1

				if firefly_order == 0 then
					firefly_order = -1
					self.firefly.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", firefly_order)
				else
					firefly_order = 0
					self.firefly.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", firefly_order)
				end
			end
		else
			if timer ~= 0 then
				timer = 0
				count = 1

				firefly_order = 0
				self.firefly.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", firefly_order)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	self.quest_opening_shown = false
	self.got_master_sword = false
	self.marker_count = 0
	self.is_change_weapon1 = false
	self.is_change_weapon2 = false
	self.skip_request = false

	self.master_sword_door_name = 'master_sword_door'
	self.shortcut_door1_name = 'alter_shortcut_door_1'
	self.shortcut_door2_name = 'alter_shortcut_door_2'
	self.hit_fire_preset = 'FX_hit_fire'
	self.fx_buttbounce_preset = 'FX_minotaur_buttbounce'
	self.fx_laser_preset = 'fx_s_laser_light'
	self.fx_explosion_preset = 'FX_explosion_boss'
	self.marker_name = 'forest_main'

	self.master_sword_object = nil
	self.master_sword = nil
	self.cur_dropped_item = nil
	self.master_sword_to_break = nil

	self.living_armors = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ICharacter);
	for i = 1, 4 do
		self.living_armors:Add(get_character(string.format('livingarmor_%d', i)))
	end

	self.altar = get_field_object('master_sword_alter')
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local quest_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('QuestData')
	self.quest_spec = quest_data:GetQuest(self.quest_id)
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	self.scene:add_callback('DropLasercannon', { controller = self, func = self.drop_laser_cannon })
	self.scene:add_callback('LootLasercannon', { controller = self, func = self.loot_laser_cannon })
	self.scene:add_callback('ShakeLasercannon', { controller = self, func = self.shake_laser_cannon })
	self.scene:add_callback('HyperSetWeapon', { controller = self, func = self.hyper_set_weapon })
	self.scene:add_callback('DropBeeper', { controller = self, func = self.drop_beeper })
	self.scene:add_callback('LootBeeper', { controller = self, func = self.loot_beeper })
	self.scene:add_callback('MasterSwordEffect', { controller = self, func = self.master_sword_effect })
	self.scene:add_callback('ShowWeapon', { controller = self, func = self.show_weapon })
	self.scene:add_callback('HideWeapon', { controller = self, func = self.hide_weapon })
	self.scene:add_callback('OpenShortCutDoor', { controller = self, func = self.open_shortcut_door })

	self.scene:add_callback('ShowKey', { controller = self, func = self.show_key })
	self.scene:add_callback('BlacksmithFallDown', { controller = self, func = self.blacksmith_fall_down })
	self.scene:add_callback('HammerTime', { controller = self, func = self.hammer_time })
	self.scene:add_callback('HyperEmerge', { controller = self, func = self.hyper_emerge })
	self.scene:add_callback('ShootCannon', { controller = self, func = self.shoot_cannon })
	self.scene:add_callback('RestoreWeapon', { controller = self, func = self.restore_weapon })

	if (self.quest_progress ~= nil) then

		for i = 0, self.living_armors.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.living_armors[i], "disabled")
		end

		character_util.set_position(self.blacksmith, vector(25, 0, 24.5))
		character_util.set_anim(self.blacksmith, { name = 'idle' })
	end

	if (user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId)) then
		character_util.set_position(self.blacksmith, vector(44.5, 0, 23))
		character_util.set_anim(self.blacksmith, { name = 'idle' })

		message_system:Publish(CS.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.shortcut_door1_name))
		message_system:Publish(CS.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.shortcut_door2_name))

		self.altar.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	else
		if (self.quest_progress ~= nil) then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, 27, true, vector(26.5, 0, 5.5))

			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString('blacksmith_and_hyper_tracker_0'))
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, 27, true, self.blacksmith)

			self.altar_interactable = self.altar.Interactable
			self.altar.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	end

	-- 연출용 이펙트들 PreLoad
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_fire_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_buttbounce_preset);
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_laser_preset);
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_explosion_preset);

	self.scene:setting()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		self:on_stage_loaded_event()
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.EquipmentChangedEvent) then
		self:on_equipment_changed_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if (target == self.altar and self.quest_progress ~= nil) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.master_sword_event, self))
	elseif (target == self.blacksmith) then
		if (user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId)) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.blacksmith, { key = "blacksmith_and_hyper_script_0" })
		elseif (self.quest_progress ~= nil) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.blacksmith, { key = "blacksmith_and_hyper_script_1" })
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_request, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if (e.BattleGroupName == "living_armor") then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.golem_defeated, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_equipment_changed_event(e)
	if (e.Slot == CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1) then
		self.is_change_weapon1 = true
	elseif (e.Slot == CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2) then
		self.is_change_weapon2 = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader_full_enter = e.FullEnter == true and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (leader_full_enter == true and zone_name == "blacksmith_appear") then
		if (self.quest_progress == nil and self.quest_opening_shown == false) then
			self.quest_opening_shown = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
		end
	elseif (leader_full_enter and zone_name == "strengthen_weapon" and self.quest_progress ~= nil and
			user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId) == false and self.got_master_sword) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_end, self))
	elseif (leader_full_enter and zone_name == "blacksmith_marker_1") then
		if (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.marker_count < 1) then
			self.marker_count = 1

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, vector(44.5, 0, 5.5))
		end
	elseif (leader_full_enter and zone_name == "blacksmith_marker_2") then
		if (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.marker_count < 2) then
			self.marker_count = 2

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.altar.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event()
	if (self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete
			and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0) then
		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.blacksmith)
	end

	if (self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false) then
		local sword_pos = vector(self.altar.Position.x, 0.65, 25.2)

		self.master_sword_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(sword_pos)
		self.master_sword = self.master_sword_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		self.master_sword.ShadowActive = false
		self.master_sword:SetItem('master_sword')
		self.master_sword.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(30, 0, -135))
		self.master_sword.Position = sword_pos
		self.master_sword.Item.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	end
end

function local_class:quest_start()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide();
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:opening())

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.blacksmith)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:quest_request()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.blacksmith)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(character_util.align_party(self.blacksmith, "left"))

	if (self.skip_request == false) then
		coroutine.yield(self.scene:talk_with_blacksmith())

		self.skip_request = true
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if (accepted) then
		if (self.altar_interactable ~= nil) then
			self.altar.Interactable = self.altar_interactable
		end

		self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.StartQuest(self.controller, self.quest_progress))

		ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, vector(26.5, 0, 5.5))

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("blacksmith_and_hyper_tracker_0"))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())

		local float_text = CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(user_party_leader)
		if (float_text ~= nil) then
			float_text:ActivateForQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		end

		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.blacksmith)
	else
		self.quest_progress = nil

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.blacksmith)
	end

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
end

function local_class:master_sword_event()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	ui_quest_marker:Show(false)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local dest_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	dest_list:Add(vector(44, 0, 26))
	dest_list:Add(vector(45, 0, 26))
	dest_list:Add(vector(43, 0, 26))
	dest_list:Add(vector(46, 0, 26))

	local dir_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Direction)
	dir_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	dir_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	dir_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	dir_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if (user_party_leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		elseif (user_party_leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
			if (member.Position.x < 44) then
				waypoints:Add(vector(42.3, 0, 24))
				waypoints:Add(vector(42.3, 0, 26))
			else
				waypoints:Add(vector(45.7, 0, 24))
				waypoints:Add(vector(45.7, 0, 26))
			end
		elseif (user_party_leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
			waypoints:Add(vector(45.7, 0, 26))
		else
			waypoints:Add(vector(42.3, 0, 26))
		end

		waypoints:Add(dest_list[i])

		character_util.set_anim(member, { name = "walk" })

		character_util.move_waypoint(member, waypoints, 3, false,
				'stop', 'floor', dir_list[i])
	end

	local waited = 0

	while (waited ~= user_party.Count) do
		waited = 0;

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[i];

			if (member.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) then
				character_util.set_anim(member, { name = "idle" })
				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:get_master_sword())

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear, 'none')

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.7))

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	self.master_sword_object:Dispose()
	self.master_sword_object = nil
	self.master_sword = nil

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if (i ~= 0) then
			character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = "victory_extra" })
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	user_party_leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
			CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName("master_sword_normal")))

	while (self.is_change_weapon1 == false) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local swordHolder = create_item_placeholder(
			{ id = item_data:GetSpec("master_sword_normal").Id, not_for_inventory = true })
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(swordHolder, 'master_blade_subtitle',
			'master_blade_description'))

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:livingarmor_emerge())

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.master_sword_door_name))

	ui_quest_marker:Show(true)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("blacksmith_and_hyper_tracker_2"))

	for i = 0, self.living_armors.Count - 1 do
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToMonster(self.living_armors[i], 'living_armor')

		local cmd = CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(self.living_armors[i], user_party_leader,
				CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle)
		CS.Oak.CommandDispatcher.Execute(cmd)
		cmd:Dispose()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- altar의 Interactable 제거
	self.altar.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:quest_end()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.blacksmith)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:ending())

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_reward_fanfare_01')

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString("weapon_enhance_unlocked"), 0, 1))
	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('weapon_enhance_unlocked_guide'), 0, 1))
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	quest_util.complete_quest(self, 0)

	-- 켄터베리 숲 메인퀘스트 마커를 할당해줌
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, 27, true,
			get_field_object("keydoor_forest_1"))

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
end

	end

end

function local_class:master_sword_move()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_y = self.master_sword.Position.y
	local end_y = self.master_sword.Position.y + 0.4
	local move_time = 4.5

	while ((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) < move_time) do
		local normal_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_time
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_y, end_y, normal_time)

		self.master_sword.Position = self.master_sword.Position:GetX0z(cur_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.master_sword.Position = self.master_sword.Position:GetX0z(end_y)
end

function local_class:shake_laser_cannon_process()
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_x = self.cur_dropped_item.SpriteTransform.position.x
	local end_x = self.cur_dropped_item.SpriteTransform.position.x - 0.3
	local cur_y = self.cur_dropped_item.SpriteTransform.position.y
	local cur_z = self.cur_dropped_item.SpriteTransform.position.z
	local shake_time = 0.3

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_touch_laser_cannon_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_time) do
		local normal_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (shake_time * 0.5)
		normal_time = normal_time > 1 and 2 - normal_time or normal_time
		local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_x, end_x, normal_time)

		self.cur_dropped_item:SetPosition(vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.4))

	end_x = self.cur_dropped_item.SpriteTransform.position.x + 0.3

	for i = 1, 2 do
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_touch_laser_cannon_01')

		while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_time) do
			local normal_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (shake_time * 0.5)
			normal_time = normal_time > 1 and 2 - normal_time or normal_time
			local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_x, end_x, normal_time)

			self.cur_dropped_item:SetPosition(vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z))

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:blacksmith_fall_down()
	character_util.set_anim(self.blacksmith, { name = 'hammer', loop = false, scale = 0.75 })
	character_util.set_position(self.blacksmith,
			vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 15, user_party_leader.Position.z - 0.7))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local blacksmith_pos = self.blacksmith.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(1, 14.2, 0)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_blacksmith_shout_long_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.blacksmith, blacksmith_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * dist_y, true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.blacksmith, vector(blacksmith_pos.x, 0, blacksmith_pos.z))
	self.blacksmith:SetAnimation('idle', true)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_big_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_buttbounce_preset):Instantiate(self.blacksmith.Position)
	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

	user_party_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	user_party_leader:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
	user_party_leader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local friction_time = 0.7
	local player_pos = user_party_leader.Position
	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 4560, 0.3)
	local friction_clone = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 4560, 0.3)
	friction_clone:Proceed(friction_time)

	local player_fin_pos = player_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * friction_clone:GetDistance()

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	self.master_sword_to_break = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = player_pos,
		target = player_fin_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.25),
		itemid = item_data:GetSpec('master_sword_normal').Id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})

	free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(4, 11.2, 0, 0)

	user_party_leader.SpineController:Rotate(720, 0.7)

	if (user_party_leader.CharacterInfo ~= nil) then
		music_player:PlayVoice(user_party_leader.CharacterInfo, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Damaged1)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_hit_wall_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		local dist_z = friction:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader,
				player_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * dist_y + unity_class.vector3.forward * dist_z, true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z))
	user_party_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	user_party_leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	user_party_leader:SetEmotion('confused', true)

	local vec_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local cur_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	local target_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	local re_members = user_party.Count - 1
	if (re_members == 1) then
		local ref_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers)
	elseif (re_members == 2) then
		local angle_range = 45
		local dist = CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers

		local ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)
	elseif (re_members == 3) then
		local angle_range = 60
		local dist = CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * 1.25
		local ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)

		ref_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle_range, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_dir) * -1
		vec_list:Add(target_pos + ref_dir * dist)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(vec_list[i - 1])

		character_util.move_waypoint(user_party[i], waypoint_list, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', cur_dir)
	end

	local waited = 0

	while (waited ~= user_party.Count - 1) do
		waited = 0

		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if (user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) then
				user_party[i]:SetAnimation('idle', true)

				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:hammer_time()
	self.blacksmith:SetAnimation('attack', true)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		member:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hammer_effect, self))

	stage.StageCamera:ResizeTo(3, 3.5)

	local duration = 0.2
	local time_passed = 0
	while (time_passed < duration) do
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			user_party[i].Position = user_party[i].Position - vector(unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1, 0, 0)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear, 'none')

	stage.StageCamera:ResizeToDefault(0)
end

	local walker = 0

	while (walker < 7) do
		music_player:PlaySfx('02_axe_slash_01')

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.25))

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_fire_preset):Instantiate(self.master_sword_to_break.Position)

		stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.07, 0.1)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.25))

		walker = walker + 1
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.6))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_big_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_break_bottle_01')

end

function local_class:hyper_emerge()
	stage.StageCamera:Move(vector(49.5, 0, 25), 0.5, nil, true)

	local audio_source_holder
	local sfx = '01_hyper_emerge_01'
	if CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan then
		sfx = '03_gimmick_jingle_01'
		audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = sfx, loop = true, delay = 1.5 })
	else
		audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(sfx)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	self.hyper.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.hyper:SetAnimation('get', true)
	self.hyper:SetEmotion('attack', true)

	stage.StageCamera:ResizeTo(3, 0.3)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local hyper_pos = self.hyper.Position
	local hyper_target_pos = vector(46.5, 0, 25)
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, 3, 0)
	local slow_start_time = 0.3
	local slow_end_time = 0.6
	local is_slowed = false
	local is_slow_fin = false

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		local normal_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fall_time
		local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(hyper_pos.x, hyper_target_pos.x, normal_time)

		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.hyper, vector(cur_x, hyper_pos.y + dist_y, hyper_pos.z), true)

		if (unity_class.time.time - cur_time > slow_start_time and is_slowed == false) then
			is_slowed = true
			CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, 'hyper_emerge')
		end

		if (unity_class.time.time - cur_time > slow_end_time and is_slow_fin == false) then
			is_slow_fin = true
			CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('hyper_emerge')

			self.hyper:SetEmotion('tired', true)
			self.hyper:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

			stage.StageCamera:Move(vector(46.5, 0, 25), 0.3, nil, true)
			stage.StageCamera:ResizeToDefault(0.3)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.hyper, self.hyper.Position:GetX0z())

	audio_source_holder:Stop();

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))

	self.hyper:RemoveAnimation()
end

function local_class:shoot_cannon()
	self.hyper.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hyper_laser_01')

	local laser_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_laser_preset):Instantiate(vector(47.5, 2, 21.5))
	laser_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		user_party[i]:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	end

	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 1.7)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.5))

	laser_effect:Dispose()

	self.hyper.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	lua_helper.call_interface(self.master_sword_to_break, 'System.IDisposable', 'Dispose')

	local ci = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo
	if (ci ~= nil) then
		user_party_leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, ci.Weapon1, false)
		user_party_leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, ci.Weapon2)
	end

	})

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	end

		self:setting_pre()
		return

		if qp.IsComplete then

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'throne_reset_zone' and e.FullLeave then
			local throne = self:get_frozen()
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, throne) then
				local reset_switch = get_field_object(throne.FieldObjectBehaviour.ResetSwitchName)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(reset_switch))
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:arthas_pushable()
	local throne = self:get_frozen()
	local arthas = self:get_arthas()
	arthas.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.firstmove = true
	local playsfx = true

	repeat
		if arthas.Position ~= throne.Position and self.firstmove and throne.Position ~= self.original_position then
			self.firstmove = false
		end
		if arthas.Position ~= throne.Position and playsfx then
			playsfx = false
			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01' })
		end
		if arthas.Position == throne.Position and not playsfx then
			playsfx = true
		end
		character_util.set_position(arthas, throne.Position)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	until self.arthas_melt
end

function local_class:setting_post()
	local throne = self:get_frozen()
	local torch = self:get_torch()
	local arthas = self:get_arthas()
	local uther = self:get_uther()
	local jaina = self:get_jaina()

	throne.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.arthas_melt = true

	character_util.set_position(arthas, torch.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_anim(arthas, { name = 'idle' , loop = false})

	local uther_dest = throne.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local jaina_dest = throne.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward + 1 * unity_class.vector3.right
	character_util.set_position(uther, uther_dest)
	character_util.set_position(jaina, jaina_dest)
	character_util.set_direction(uther, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'down')
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		local sw = self:get_master_switch()

			self.first_switch = false
			local door1 = self:get_door_1()

function local_class:setting_pre()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')
	--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event' )

	local screw_int = self:get_screw_interactable()
	screw_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local wire_int = self:get_wire_interactable()
	wire_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local gear_int = self:get_gear_interactable()
	gear_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local parts = self:get_parts()

	for i,v in ipairs(parts) do
		if is_unity_null(v[1]) then
			local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')

			self.parts[i] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = v[2],
					  target = nil,
					  itemid = item_data:GetSpec(v[3]).Id,
					  notforinven = true,
					  markforpick = false,
					  lootstate = 'findlooter' })

			self.parts[i].PickFlyDistance = 0.5

			self.parts[i].Position =  self.parts[i].Position + 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.up
			self.fx[i] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(
					self.parts[i].SpriteTransform.position, CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity, self.parts[i].SpriteTransform)
		end
	end

	self.get_parts_status = { false, false, false }

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(self.res_holder, self.teatans_path, self.teatans_name,
			function (prefab)
				local obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.iron_teatans = obj:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.IronTeatans))
				self.iron_teatans.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
				self.iron_teatans.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
				self.iron_teatans.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
				self.iron_teatans.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				self.iron_teatans.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(2.5, 1, 2.5))
				self.iron_teatans.Transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				self.iron_teatans:Init()
			end))
	local man = self:get_man()
	self.iron_teatans.Position = man.Position + 100 * unity_class.vector3.left
end

function local_class:setting_post()
	local man = self:get_man()
	local parts = self:get_parts()

	character_util.set_active_state(man, 'disabled')

	for i,v in ipairs(parts) do
		v.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	local screw_int = self:get_screw_interactable()
	screw_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local wire_int = self:get_wire_interactable()
	wire_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local gear_int = self:get_gear_interactable()
	gear_int.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

	local parts = self:get_parts()
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
	local tmp = create_item_placeholder({ id = item_data:GetSpec(parts[item_idx][3]).Id , not_for_inventory = true})

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,
			tmp,
			parts[item_idx][4][1],
			parts[item_idx][4][2],
			parts[item_idx][4][3]
	)

--[[
-- 쓰레기 더미 생성 : FoxMainSection15.lua 참조
function local_class:generate_trash()
	self.trash_list = {}
	local count = 0
	while count < 30 do
		local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, 1)
		local z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, 1)

		local throw_pos = vector(self.gear_pos[1], self.gear_pos[2], self.gear_pos[3]) + vector(x, 0, z)

		local random_count = count % 7 + 1
		local itemid
		if random_count == 1 then

		elseif random_count == 2 then
			itemid = 20173
		elseif random_count == 3 then
			itemid = 20019
		elseif random_count == 4 then
			itemid = 20009
		elseif random_count == 5 then
			itemid = 20051
		elseif random_count == 6 then
			itemid = 20081
		else
			itemid = 20014
		end

		local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = throw_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

		local rotation = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 360)

		trash_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotation, 0)
		table.insert(self.trash_list, trash_item)

	end

function local_class:popup_cloud_preset(codes, min_delay, max_delay, min_font_size, max_font_size, life_time, alpha_fade_time)
	alpha_fade_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(alpha_fade_time, -1)

	-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
	local code_interval_large = 1.4 / (#codes + 1)
	local code_interval_small = code_interval_large / 4

	-- 평균 시간 계산
	local standard_delay = (min_delay + max_delay) / 2

	-- 홀수, 짝수 시의 시간 간격 저장
	local saved_delay = 0

	for i = 1, #codes do
		-- 말구름 시작 위치 y값 랜덤으로 설정
		local curX = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.3, 0.3)
		local curY = 0
		if #codes == 1 then
			curY = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.7, 0.7)
		else
			-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
			local curY_middle = -0.7 + code_interval_large * i
			local curY_min = curY_middle + code_interval_small
			local curY_max = curY_middle + code_interval_small * 3

			curY = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(curY_min, curY_max)
		end


		-- 말구름 폰트 사이즈 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_font_size = random_util.get_random_int(min_font_size, max_font_size)

		-- 말구름 색상 5개 준비
		local special_color = {CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 0, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 0, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 255, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 0, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 255, 255)}

		-- 말구름 색상 랜덤으로 설정 (색상 들어갈 확률 5/15)
		local color_rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 15)
		local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255)

		if color_rand <= 5 then
			color = special_color[color_rand]
		end

		-- 말구름 생성
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(codes[i]),
				vector(curX, curY), 0, 9999, cur_font_size, 0, vector(-1, 0), 0, life_time, color, alpha_fade_time))

		-- 랜덤으로 대기
		-- index가 짝수 : 현재 딜레이를 저장하고 다음으로 이동
		-- index가 홀수 : 짝수 값에 맞춰서 두 딜레이를 더한 값이 평균이 되도록 설정한 뒤 다음으로 이동
		local cur_delay = (i % 2 == 0) and CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_delay, max_delay) or 2 * standard_delay - saved_delay

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			saved_delay = cur_delay
		end

		wait_for_sec(cur_delay)
	end
end

function local_class:world_cloud_preset(codes, min_delay, max_delay, min_font_size, max_font_size, move_updown)
	-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
	local code_interval_large = 1.4 / (#codes + 1)
	local code_interval_small = code_interval_large / 4

	-- 평균 시간 계산
	local standard_delay = (min_delay + max_delay) / 2

	-- 홀수, 짝수 시의 시간 간격 저장
	local saved_delay = 0

	for i = 1, #codes do
		-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
		local curY_middle = -0.7 + code_interval_large * i
		local curY_min = curY_middle + code_interval_small
		local curY_max = curY_middle + code_interval_small * 3

		-- 말구름 시작 위치 y값 랜덤으로 설정
		local curX = 1.5
		if move_updown then
			curX = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		end
		local curY = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(curY_min, curY_max)

		-- 말구름 폰트 사이즈 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_font_size = random_util.get_random_int(min_font_size, max_font_size)
		local cur_speed = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.75, 0.85)

		-- 말구름 색상 5개 준비
		local special_color = {CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 0, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 0, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 255, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 0, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 255, 255)}

		-- 말구름 색상 랜덤으로 설정 (색상 들어갈 확률 5/15)
		local color_rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 15)
		local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255)

		if color_rand <= 5 then
			color = special_color[color_rand]
		end

		if move_updown then
			-- 말구름 생성
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(codes[i]),
					vector(curX, -0.7), 0, 9999, cur_font_size, 0, vector(0, 1), cur_speed, 10, color))
		else
			-- 말구름 생성
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(codes[i]),
					vector(curX, curY), 0, 9999, cur_font_size, 0, vector(-1, 0), cur_speed, 10, color))
		end

		-- 랜덤으로 대기
		-- index가 짝수 : 현재 딜레이를 저장하고 다음으로 이동
		-- index가 홀수 : 짝수 값에 맞춰서 두 딜레이를 더한 값이 평균이 되도록 설정한 뒤 다음으로 이동
		local cur_delay = (i % 2 == 0) and CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_delay, max_delay) or 2 * standard_delay - saved_delay

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			saved_delay = cur_delay
		end

		wait_for_sec(cur_delay)
	end
end

function local_class:load_retire_narration_box()
	self.retire_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	coroutine.yield(self.retire_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "RetireNarrationBox"), function(p)
		local box_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		self.retire_narration_box = box_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.CafeRetireNarrationBox))

	if self.retire_narration_box ~= nil then

		self.retire_res_holder = nil
