function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
			self.letter = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = vector(17.5, 1, 163.8),
			                                           itemid = self.letter_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
			self.letter.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

			if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
				if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 4 then
					local blocker = get_field_object(self.blocker_name)
					blocker.Position = vector(42, 0, 120)

					for i = 1, self.fire_gift_num do
						stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.fire_gift_name..i, 'disabled')
					end
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rest_area_worker()) and not self.interacting_worker then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
				--…이 스파게티 설계도 좀 보라고. 대체 이걸 누가 완성시킬지…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_rest_area_worker(),
						'christmas_main_s4_new_rest_area_1')
			elseif self.is_first_talk_with_worker then
				--첫 상호작용 시
				self.is_first_talk_with_worker = false
				self.interacting_worker = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_talk_with_worker, self)
			else
				-- 완성 / 미완성 여부는 안쪽에서 판단할 것임
				self.interacting_worker = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_about_rest_area, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 4 then
		return
	end

	if zone_name == self.square_event_zone_name and self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_square_event then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_square_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.square_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.main_facility_event_zone_name and
			self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_main_facility_event and
			self.quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_main_facility_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off_main_facility_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.strike_off_1_event_zone_name and
			self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_strike_event_1 then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_strike_event_1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off_event_1, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.strike_off_2_event_zone_name and
			self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_strike_event_2 and
			self.quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_strike_event_2

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off_event_2, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.strike_off_3_event_zone_name and
			self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_strike_event_3 then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_strike_event_3

		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off_event_3, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.desk) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_desk, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.enter_section_4 then
			-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터 일부 비활성화
			if self.optimized_npcs_2 ~= nil and self.experimental_destroy_character then
				load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs_2)
				self.optimized_npcs_2 = nil
			end
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.enter_section_5 then
			-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 제거
			if self.optimized_npcs_1 ~= nil and self.experimental_destroy_character then
				load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs_1)
				self.optimized_npcs_1 = nil
			end

			-- 불타는 선물 제거
			for i = 1, self.fire_gift_num do
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.fire_gift_name..i, 'disabled')
			end

			-- Brazier 제거
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.brazier_name, 'disabled')

			-- Fire Floor 제거
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.gift_fire_floor_name, 'disabled')

			-- 화로 엘프 제거
			character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.brazier_elf_name), 'disabled')

			-- 광장 캠프파이어 이펙트 제거
			if self.campfire_effect ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.campfire_effect)
				self.campfire_effect = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- 대기 상태일 때만 받아옴
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'xmas_survival_build_game_response'
			and self.current_build_game_state == self.build_game_state.responding then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'success' then
			self.current_build_game_state = self.build_game_state.success
		else
			self.current_build_game_state = self.build_game_state.fail
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
		self:set_new_car_event()

		-- FIXME : load_resource에서 세팅하면 무조건 false가 되어서 세팅 위치를 일단 이쪽으로 바꿔줌. 원인 파악 필요
		if self:is_rest_area_clue_collected() then
			self.get_rest_area_worker().Interactable.Talk = 'christmas_main_s4_new_rest_area_2'

			-- 스타피스 획득이 안되어있을 때
			if not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.rest_area_star_piece_name) then
				-- FIXME : load_resource에서 세팅할 수 없는 이유는 위에 나와있음. 일단 어디가 먼저 불리든지, Enabled로 바뀌도록 세팅
				local star_piece = get_field_object(self.rest_area_star_piece_name)
				star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
			end
		else
			character_util.add_listener(self.get_rest_area_worker(), self)
		end
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.convert_manual_character, self))
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

-- StageLoadedEvent 날아온 시점에서 플레이어 캐릭터 교체
function local_class:convert_manual_character(e)
	-- 1스테이지에서는 기사 캐릭터 사용
	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			self:change_manual_character(self.knight_male_name)
		else
			self:change_manual_character(self.knight_female_name)
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경 및 파티 전체 비활성화
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	local saved_party_leader = user_party_leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character, true)

	character_util.set_direction(manual_character, saved_party_leader.Direction)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

	local party_list = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local cur_party_member = user_party[i]

		table.insert(party_list, cur_party_member)
	end

	for i = 1, #party_list do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(party_list[i])

		character_util.set_active_state(party_list[i], 'disabled')
	end
end

-- 파티 리더 루돌프로 교체 (5스테이지 전용)
function local_class:set_rudolph_manual()
	local rudolph = get_character('rudolph')
	local knight = user_util.has_knight_male() and get_character('knight_male')
			or get_character('knight_female')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(knight, user_party.Leader) then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = false
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(rudolph, param, true)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(knight, user_party, true)

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, user_party_leader) then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = true
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(rudolph, param, true)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(knight, user_party, true)
	else
	end
end

		local snowdrift = self.get_snowdrift()

		snowdrift.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.snowdrift_scale)

		--DEBUG CODE : 테스트용 코드

		--self.get_brazier().Position = vector(-27, 0, 47)

			-- FIXME : load_resource에서 세팅하면 커스텀 스테이트 체크가 왜인지 안됨... 일단 항상 Enabled로 바뀌도록 세팅

function local_class:check_brazier_routine()
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local snowdrift = self.get_snowdrift()

	local check_min_pos = snowdrift.Position - self.snowdrift_hitbox_scale * 0.5 + vector(-0.6, 0, -0.6)
	local check_max_pos = snowdrift.Position + self.snowdrift_hitbox_scale * 0.5 + vector(0.6, 0, 0.6)
	local player_check_min_pos = snowdrift.Position - self.snowdrift_hitbox_scale * 0.5 + vector(-4, 0, -4)
	-- 위쪽에 조금 보여서 플레이어 체크 위치는 위로 조금 올려줌
	-- FIXME : 해상도 대응이 필요할까?
	local player_check_max_pos = snowdrift.Position + self.snowdrift_hitbox_scale * 0.5 + vector(4, 0, 4.5)

	local melting = false

	-- 쿨타임 리셋
	self.car_shake_cooldown = self.car_shake_cooltime

	while self.current_car_check_state == self.car_check_state.in_grid do
		local brazier_pos = brazier.Position
		local leader_pos = leader.Position

		local brazier_near_snow = check_min_pos.x < brazier_pos.x and brazier_pos.x < check_max_pos.x
				and check_min_pos.z < brazier_pos.z and brazier_pos.z < check_max_pos.z

		if brazier_near_snow then
			-- 녹이기 시작했을 때만 Shake 실행시켜줌
			if not melting then
				snowdrift:Shake(0.08, 99999)
				self:play_sfx_snow_shake(snowdrift)
			end

			if player_check_min_pos.x < leader_pos.x and leader_pos.x < player_check_max_pos.x
					and player_check_min_pos.z < leader_pos.z and leader_pos.z < player_check_max_pos.z then
				self.car_shake_cooldown = self.car_shake_cooldown - unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if self.car_shake_cooldown <= 0 then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.new_car_appear, self)

					-- 연출을 위해 CancelShake 건너뜀
					return
				end
			end
		else
			-- 가독성을 위해 elseif 사용 안함
			if melting then
				snowdrift:CancelShake()
				self:stop_sfx_snow_shake(0.3)
			end
		end

		melting = brazier_near_snow

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	snowdrift:CancelShake()
	self:stop_sfx_snow_shake(0.3)
end

--- 눈더미 흔들리는 사운드 on / off 하는 메소드
function local_class:play_sfx_snow_shake(target)
	self.sfx_snow_shake = music_player_util.play_sfx({

		parent = target, loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'
	})
end

function local_class:stop_sfx_snow_shake(duration)
	if self.sfx_snow_shake ~= nil then
		self.sfx_snow_shake:FadeOut(duration)
	end
	self.sfx_snow_shake = nil
end

function local_class:new_car_appear()
	local snowdrift = self.get_snowdrift()
	local car = self.get_new_car()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	local sfx_eq_loop =  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_05', loop = true,
													   type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'event' })

	camera_util.move_async(snowdrift.Position, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:stop_sfx_snow_shake(1.5)
	sfx_eq_loop:FadeOut(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	snowdrift:CancelShake()
	snowdrift.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	car.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(2.5)

	self.new_car_star_piece_twinkle = unity_object_pool
			.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character'):Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(car.Bounds.center))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_windchime_01')

	-- 화로로 녹인 이벤트 종료 이후에는 필요 없으므로 구독 해제해줌
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_car_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_car_camera_grid_leave_event')

end

function local_class:interact_with_car()
	local need_save = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.quest_custom_state.new_car_clue) ~= 1
	local need_event = need_save and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3

	--새 차에 상호작용을하면

	--나레이션 박스 : 세련된 느낌, 그랜드 투어러로써의 안정감, 그리고 스포츠카로서의 성능을 모두 잡은 야심찬 모델, 카마존 AMG-GT 502 년 형이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_car_1'})

	--나레이션 박스 : 사이드 미러에 글자가 각인되어 있다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_car_2'})

	--나레이션 박스 : 크리스마스 공장 CEO, 혁신 기업가, 테크 GEEK, 와인홀릭,  감성적 합리주의자\n산타 클로스”
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_car_3'})

	if need_event then
		local leader = get_party_leader()

		--(주인공 한심한 표정으로 고민하는 포즈 잠시 한 뒤)
		local origin_dir = leader.Direction

		character_util.set_side_direction(leader)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'tired'})
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--나레이션 박스 : 산타의 고급 차에 대해서 알게 되었다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_car_4'})

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		leader.Direction = origin_dir

		-- Section4에 증거를 입수했음을 전달함
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { self.interact_with_car_event }))
	end

	-- 산타의 새 차 소재 저장
	if need_save then
		-- 반짝이 붙은거 해제
		self:dispose_car_twinkle()

		local car_center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_new_car().Bounds.center)
		local is_leader_upper = get_party_leader().Position.z > car_center_pos.z

		-- 플레이어 위치에 따라 스타피스 최종 위치 옮겨줌
		star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object(self.new_car_star_piece_name),
				car_center_pos + vector(0, 1, -0.5),
				car_center_pos + (is_leader_upper and vector(0, 0, -2) or vector(0, 0, 2)))

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.quest_custom_state.new_car_clue, 1)
	end

	self.interacting_car = false
end

function local_class:dispose_car_twinkle()
	if self.new_car_star_piece_twinkle ~= nil then
		self.new_car_star_piece_twinkle:Dispose()
	end

	self.new_car_star_piece_twinkle = nil
end

function local_class:talk_about_rest_area()
	-- 응답 대기 상태로 변경
	self.current_build_game_state = self.build_game_state.responding
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'xmas_survival_build_game_query' }));

	local worker = self.get_rest_area_worker()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--일단 주인공이 정렬해서 멈추게 하고
	party_util.align_party(worker, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 응답이 올 때까지 기다림
	while self.current_build_game_state == self.build_game_state.responding do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--끝내지 않았다면
	if self.current_build_game_state == self.build_game_state.fail then
		-- 다시 원상복구해줌
		self.current_build_game_state = self.build_game_state.idle

function local_class:tint_in_out_routine(in_color, out_color, tint_duration, shake_magnitude, shake_duration, wait_duration)
	self.is_run_tint_in_out_routine = true

	field:Tint(self.tint_key_1, in_color, 0)

	while self.is_run_tint_in_out_routine do
		camera_util.shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_2, out_color, tint_duration)
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

		if not self.is_run_tint_in_out_routine then
			break
		end

		camera_util.shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, tint_duration)
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_tint_in_out_routine()
	self.is_run_tint_in_out_routine = false

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_1, 0)
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, 0)
end

		local member = user_party[i]

function local_class:air_spin(character)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(character, user_party_leader) then
		stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)
	end

	stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'confused' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(16, 30, 0, 0)
	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 2500, 0.3)
	local cur_x = character.Position.x
	local cur_y = character.Position.y
	local cur_z = character.Position.z
	local flying_time = 2

	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 360, flying_time)
	character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, flying_time)

	local extra_z = (-35 - character.Position.z)
	if extra_z < 0 then
		extra_z = 0
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < flying_time do
		local normalized_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / flying_time
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_x = friction:GetDistance()
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		local dist_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 2 + extra_z, normalized_time)

		local cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(normalized_time, 1, -1, 1)
		character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale, 0)

		local pos = vector(cur_x + dist_x, cur_y + dist_y, cur_z + dist_z)
		character_util.set_position(character, pos, true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.statue_sister) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.statue_brother) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.narration_statue, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.sign_board_a) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.narration_sign_board_a, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.sign_board_b) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.narration_sign_board_b, self))
		elseif e.Target ~= nil and self:compare_target(e.Target)then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.narration_item, self, e.Target))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.china_merchant) and not self.entered_zone[1] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_china, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.guide) and not self.entered_zone[2] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_photo, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.clock_student) and not self.entered_zone[3] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_clock, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.otaku) and not self.entered_zone[4] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_otaku, self))
		end
	end


	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

end

function local_class:init_ghost_buster_spine()
	local weapon1, weapon2, costume

	for i = 0, user.Characters.Values.Count - 1 do

		local asset_name = user.Characters.Values[i].AssetName:ToString()

		if string.find(asset_name, "ghost_buster") then
			weapon1 = user.Characters.Values[i].Weapon1
			weapon2 = user.Characters.Values[i].Weapon2
			costume = user.Characters.Values[i].Costume
			break
		end
	end

	if costume ~= nil then
		self.ghost_buster:SetCostume(costume)
	end

	self.ghost_buster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon1, false)
	self.ghost_buster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon2, false)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.ghost_buster, "disabled")

function local_class:setup_quest()
	local is_cleared
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		is_cleared = true
	else
		is_cleared = false
	end

	self:setup_npc(is_cleared)

	local zone = field:GetZone(self.gimmick_preset_name)
	local field_objects = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, field_objects.Count - 1 do
		field_objects[i].Position = field_objects.Values[i].Position - vector(0, 0, 100)
	end

	field_objects:Dispose()

	local gimmicks = {"dt_signboard_0", "dt_signboard_1", "dt_signboard_2",
		"dt_road_0", "dt_road_1", "dt_road_2", "dt_road_3", "dt_road_4", "dt_road_5"}

	for key,value in pairs(gimmicks) do
		local gimmick = get_field_object(value)
		local marker = field:GetMarker(value)

		gimmick.Position = marker.position
	end

	self.show_case = {}

	local drop_items = {"magitonpack", "magitimes", "spirit_realizer" }

	local drop_item_offset = vector(0, 1, -0.1)

	for key,value in pairs(drop_items) do
		local fo = get_field_object(string.format("dt_interact_%s", value))
		fo.Position = field:GetMarker(string.format("dt_%s", value)).position

		local item_id = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData"):GetSpec(value).Id
		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = fo.Position + drop_item_offset,
		itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

		drop_item.ShadowTransform.position = drop_item.ShadowTransform.position + drop_item_offset

		table.insert(self.show_case, fo)
	end
end

function local_class:setup_npc(is_clear)
	local characters = {
		"statue_sister", "statue_brother", "statue_sister_mini", "statue_brother_mini", "guide_npc", "otaku",
		"info_student_4", "info_student_5", "info_student_6", "info_student_7", "info_student_8", "president",
		"teacher1", "teacher2", "student2", "student3", "china_merchant", "ghost_cloak_student", "onigirl"
	}

	local animations = {
		"idle", "idle", "idle", "idle", "idle", "sing",
		"cross_arm", "sing", "idle", "idle", "idle", "throw",
		"idle", "cast", "push", "idle", "push", "victory_extra", "idle"
	}

	local emotions = {
		"idle", "idle", "idle", "idle", "idle", "love",
		"tired", "tired", "idle", "idle", "idle", "idle",
		"idle", "smile", "awesome", "idle", "idle", "idle", "idle"
	}

	local start_index

	if is_clear then
		start_index = 3
	else
		start_index = 1
	end

	for i = start_index, #characters do
		local c = get_character(characters[i])
		local marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("dt_%s", characters[i]))
		character_util.set_active_state(c, "enabled")
		c:RemoveAnimation()
		c:RemoveEmotion()

		c.Position = marker.position
		character_util.set_direction(c, marker.direction)

		if c.Interactable ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim(c, {name = animations[i]})
			character_util.set_emotion(c, {name = emotions[i]})

			local str = string.format("dt_%s", characters[i])
			local desc = game_string:GetString(str)

			if desc ~= str and c.Interactable ~= nil then
				c.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

				if is_clear then
					c.Interactable.Talk = string.format("dtc_%s", characters[i])
				else
					c.Interactable.Talk = string.format("dt_%s", characters[i])
				end

				c.Interactable.ShowNextTalkWhenInteract = false
			end
		end
	end

	if is_clear then
		local president = get_character(self.president_name)

		if president == nil then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_anim(president, {name = "cross_arm"})
		character_util.set_emotion(president, {name = "doyagao"})
	end
end

function local_class:hide_npc_list(fading)
	if self.cached_npc_active_state ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.cached_npc_active_state = {}
	local npc_lists = self:get_npc_list()

	if not fading then
		for i = 1, #npc_lists do
			local npc = npc_lists[i]
			local is_active = npc.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			if is_active then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0.5)
			end
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- Npc들을 disabled 시켜준다.
	for i = 1, #npc_lists do
		local npc = npc_lists[i]
		local is_active = npc.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		if is_active then
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		end
		table.insert(self.cached_npc_active_state, is_active)
	end

	-- 쓰레기통에서 꼬마가 나오는 이벤트를 보지 않았을 때
	if not self.is_show_garbage_event then
		-- 쓰레기통을 disable 시킨다
		local trash_can = self.get_trash_can()
		trash_can.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:show_npc_list(fading)
	if self.cached_npc_active_state == nil then
		return
	end

	-- NPC들을 Enabled 시켜준다.
	local npc_lists = self:get_npc_list()
	for i = 1, #npc_lists do
		if self.cached_npc_active_state[i] then
			local is_change_duration = i ~= 1 or self.is_boy_alpha
			if is_change_duration then
				local duration = fading and 0 or 1
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc_lists[i], 1, duration)
			end
			character_util.set_active_state(npc_lists[i], 'enabled')
		end
	end

	-- 쓰레기통에서 꼬마가 나오는 이벤트를 보지 않았을 때
	if not self.is_show_garbage_event then
		-- 쓰레기통을 enabled 시킨다
		local trash_can = self.get_trash_can()
		trash_can.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	self.cached_npc_active_state = nil
end

function local_class:get_npc_list()
	local npc_lists = {}
	local boy = self.get_boy()
	table.insert(npc_lists, boy)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.get_girl(i)
		table.insert(npc_lists, girl)
		local bad_guy = self.get_bad_guy(i)
		table.insert(npc_lists, bad_guy)
	end

	return npc_lists
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			if e.Fade == true then
				self:enable_npc(self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc, 0)
			else
				self:enable_npc(self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc, 0.5)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 켜줄 때 이미 물물교환이 끝난 npc는 키지 않도록
function local_class:enable_npc(npc_table, duration)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(216)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

	-- 메인이 6이하면 모두 disabled이므로 무시
	if main_quest_inner_progress < 7 then
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 컴플리트 상태면 모두 disabled이므로 무시
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)

	-- order이 custom_state보다 낮은 npc는 이미 교환을 마친 npc이므로 따로 켜주지 않는다.
	-- order이 같은 npc는 현재 교환 이벤트를 해야하므로 AddListener 한다.
	-- order이 더 큰 npc는 대화 이벤트만 있으므로 talk만 지정
	for i = 1, #npc_table do
		local npc = self.get_npc(npc_table[i].name)
		if npc_table[i].order == custom_state then
			if npc_table[i].is_emoticon then
				npc_table[i].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true })
			end

			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			-- 대화가 없는 NPC ( 애완견, 와이번 )은 AddListener 추가하지 않음
			if npc_table[i].talk ~= '' then
				npc.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, duration)

		elseif npc_table[i].order > custom_state then
			if npc_table[i].is_emoticon then
				npc_table[i].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true })
			end

			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_table[i].talk
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, duration)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:disable_npc(npc_table, duration)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(216)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

	-- 메인이 6이하면 모두 disabled이므로 무시
	if main_quest_inner_progress < 7 then
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 컴플리트 상태면 모두 disabled이므로 무시
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)

	for i = 1, #npc_table do
		local npc = self.get_npc(npc_table[i].name)
		if npc_table[i].order >= custom_state then
			if npc_table[i].is_emoticon then
				if npc_table[i].emoticon ~= nil then
					npc_table[i].emoticon:Clear()
					npc_table[i].emoticon = nil
				end
			end
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, duration)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_exchange_item(item_num, npc_num)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,
			{ItemId = item_num},
			'demonworld_exchange_item_' .. npc_num .. '_1',
			'demonworld_exchange_item_' .. npc_num .. '_2',
			'demonworld_exchange_item_' .. npc_num .. '_3', 1)
end

-- 2스테이지 NPC init 메인챕터와 겹치지 않기 위해 섹션이 7보다 낮으면 등장하지 않는다.
function local_class:init_stage_2()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(216)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

	if main_quest_inner_progress < 7 then
		self.get_npc('exchange_npc_2').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		self.get_npc('exchange_npc_3').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	else
		local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)
		if custom_state <= 2 then
			-- 도넛 쥐어주기
			local npc_2 = self.get_npc('exchange_npc_2')
			npc_2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'donut_bite')
			character_util.set_anim(npc_2, { name = 'sword_idle'})
			self.exchange_npc_table[1].npc[1].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc_2.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true, emoticon_time = {0, 1, 0} })
		end

		if custom_state <= 3 then
			-- 빠루 쥐어주기
			local npc_3 = self.get_npc('exchange_npc_3')
			npc_3.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'mall_crowbar')
			character_util.set_anim(npc_3, { name = 'sword_idle'})
			self.exchange_npc_table[1].npc[2].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc_3.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true, emoticon_time = {0, 1, 0} })
		end
	end
end

-- 3스테이지 NPC init 그레모리만 퀘스트 complete 상태여도 위치를 초기화 해준다.
function local_class:init_stage_3()
	local get_mad_scientist = function() return get_character('mad_scientist') end

	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(216)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress
	local mad_scientist = get_mad_scientist()

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		mad_scientist.Position = field:GetMarker('exchange_mad_scientist_pos').position
		character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'down')
		return
	end

	if main_quest_inner_progress ~= 7 then
		mad_scientist.Position = field:GetMarker('exchange_mad_scientist_pos').position
		character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, { name = 'tired' })
		mad_scientist.Interactable.Talk = 'demonworld_exchange_15'
	end

	if custom_state > 6 then
		return
	end

	if custom_state <= 1 then
		local npc_1 = self.get_npc('exchange_npc_1')
		self.exchange_npc_table[2].npc[1].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc_1.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true })
	end

	if custom_state <= 4 then
		local npc_4 = self.get_npc('exchange_npc_4_1')
		self.exchange_npc_table[2].npc[2].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc_4.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true })
	end
end

function local_class:init_stage_lilith()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)

	if custom_state > 6 then
		return
	end

	if custom_state <= 5 then
		local npc_5 = self.get_npc('exchange_npc_5_1')
		self.exchange_npc_table[3].npc[1].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(npc_5.transform, nil, 'exchange', nil, {no_time_limit = true })
	end
end


function local_class:clear_emoticon(npc)
	for i = 1, #self.exchange_npc_table do
		if stage.Name == self.exchange_npc_table[i].stage_name then
			for k = 1, #self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc do
				if self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc[k].name == npc then
					if self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc[k].emoticon ~= nil then
						self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc[k].emoticon:Clear()
						self.exchange_npc_table[i].npc[k].emoticon = nil
					end
					break
				end
			end
			break
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

	end

			or self.cur_prison_npc_state == self.prison_npc_state.with_ellen then
		self:set_default_prison_npc()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(prison_guard, self)

	local chief = self.get_chief()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(chief, self)

	local ellen = self.get_ellen()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(ellen, self)

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)

			self.can_operate_quest = false
			self.should_reset = true
			if not self.is_auto_moving then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_routine, self, true ,e.Fade))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key then
			self.can_operate_quest = true
			self.should_reset = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_routine, self, false ,e.Fade))
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 or self.quest_progress.Grade >= 0 then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(
				CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE))
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

function local_class:exclusive_routine(turned_on, fade, remove_anim)
	local louis = self.get_louis()
	local melanie = self.get_melanie()
	local car = self.get_louis_car()
	local npcs = {}

	if louis == nil then return end
	table.insert(npcs, louis)
	if melanie ~= nil then
		table.insert(npcs, melanie)
	end

	local size = table_util.get_size(npcs)

	if remove_anim then
		for i = 1, size do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs[i])
		end
	end

	local state = 'enabled'
	local alpha_to = 1
	self.exclusive_called = turned_on

	if turned_on then
		state = 'disabled'
		alpha_to = 0
	end

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 1 then
		if turned_on then
			car.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		else
			car.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end
	end

	if fade then
		for i = 1, size do
			character_util.set_active_state(npcs[i], state)
		end
		self.is_fading = true
	else
		for i = 1, size do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[i], alpha_to, 1)
		end
		wait_for_sec(1)
		for i = 1, size do
			character_util.set_active_state(npcs[i], state)
		end
		self.is_fading = false
	end
end

function local_class:reset_routine(remove_anim)
	local removeanim = lua_helper.get_or_default(remove_anim, false)
	if self.should_reset then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_routine, self, true, self.is_fading, removeanim))

		if not self.is_fading then
			wait_for_sec(1.1)
		end

		if self.is_auto_moving then
			self.is_auto_moving = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:melanie_dead_narration()
	-- 대답이 없다. 평범한 시체인 모양이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_27'})

	wait_for_sec(jump_dur)
	for i = 1, n do

		character_util.jump(fo, 0.5, jump_dur)

	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(louis)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(melanie, {key = ''})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(melanie)

	end

	end

	local cam_grid_name = left_grid.name

	end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)

		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'store_massage_oil' then
			local massage_oil = get_field_object('purchased_item')
			self.player_purchased_oil = true
			massage_oil.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()
			self.oil_original_pos = massage_oil.Position

			massage_oil.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			massage_oil.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
			--massage_oil.Position = self.oil_original_pos

			local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
			manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

			local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

			return true
		end

		self.player_purchased_oil = false
	end

			and lua_helper.type_compare(user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_alert, self))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	local event_key = e.Key
	local should_fade = e.Fade

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		if event_key ~= self.mugger_key then
			local mugger = self.get_mugger()

			if should_fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.fade_mugger_routine, self, mugger, 0, 'disabled'))
			else
				character_util.set_active_state(mugger, 'disabled')
			end

			character_util.remove_emotion(mugger)
			character_util.remove_anim(mugger)
			character_util.set_direction(mugger, 'down')
			mugger.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

			self.keep_avoiding = true
			self.is_mugger_slipping = false

			-- 오일 처리
			if self.oil_break_effect ~= nil then
				self.oil_break_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end

			self.is_exclusive_event_on = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	local event_key = e.Key
	local should_fade = e.Fade

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		if event_key ~= self.mugger_key then
			local mugger = self.get_mugger()

			if should_fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.fade_mugger_routine, self, mugger, 1, 'enabled'))
			else
				character_util.set_active_state(mugger, 'enabled')
			end

			if self.oil_break_effect ~= nil then

			self.is_exclusive_event_on = false
		end

	character_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state)
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local destroyed_object = e.FieldObject

	if destroyed_object.Name == 'purchased_item' and self.player_purchased_oil == true then
		self:remove_oil_range()
		self:create_oil_range(destroyed_object.Position)
		destroyed_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		destroyed_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
end

function local_class:is_close_to(from, target, range)
	local distance = vector_util.sqr_distance(from, target)

	if distance < range then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_oil_routine()
	if self.oil_break_effect == nil then return end

	local mugger = self.get_mugger()
	local player = user_party.Leader

	local oil_position = self.oil_break_effect.transform.position
	local dist_from_oil_to_mugger = vector_util.sqr_distance(oil_position, mugger.Position)
	local dist_from_oil_to_player = vector_util.sqr_distance(oil_position, player.Position)

	self.previous_state = self.is_player_on_oil

	if dist_from_oil_to_mugger < self.minimum_range then
		if not self.is_mugger_slipping then
			self.is_mugger_slipping = true
			self.keep_avoiding = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.slipped_by_oil, self, mugger))
		end
	elseif dist_from_oil_to_player < self.minimum_range then
		if not self.is_player_on_oil then
			self.is_player_on_oil = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.slipped_by_oil, self, player))
		end
	end

	local distance_from_range = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.oil_break_effect.transform.position, user_party_leader.Position)

	if distance_from_range > 1.1 then
		self.is_player_on_oil = false
	end
end

function local_class:slipped_by_oil(character)
	local is_player = lua_helper.reference_equals(character, user_party_leader)

	if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'left')
	end

	if is_player then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'sleep'})

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.64
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(5, 15, 0, 0)

	local start_pos = character.Position
	local prev_going_down = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		local is_going_down = (free_fall:GetPinnacleProgress() >= 1) and true or false

		if prev_going_down ~= is_going_down then
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
			prev_going_down = true
		end

		character_util.set_position(
				character, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

	free_fall:Dispose()

	character_util.set_position(character, vector(character.Position.x, 0, character.Position.z))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')

	if not is_player then
		local mugger = self.get_mugger()

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- 퀘스트 실행 가능한지

	-- 이팩트들
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_phone_booth_ball = function() return get_field_object('phone_booth_ball') end

	self.hang_phone_booth_zone = 'hang_phone_booth_zone'

	-- 현재 파트 상태
	self.part_state = { none = 1, part_one = 2, progress_part_one = 3, part_two = 4, progress_part_two = 5
	, part_three = 6, progress_part_three = 7, ending = 8 }
	self.cur_part_state = self.part_state.none

	-- Part1의 상태
	self.part_one_state = { none = 1, fail = 2, stun = 3, hide = 4 }
	self.cur_part_one_state = self.part_one_state.none

	-- Part2의 상태
	self.part_two_state = { none = 1, fail = 2, kill = 3, garbage_bomb = 4 }
	self.cur_part_two_state = self.part_two_state.none

	-- Part3의 상태
	self.part_three_state = { none = 1, fail = 2, success = 3 }
	self.cur_part_three_state = self.part_three_state.none

	-- 쓰레기 아이템

	-- 아이들이 공차기를 하고 있는지?
	self.is_play_ball = false

	self.is_setting_npc = false

end

	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DemonWorldPhoneBoothSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DemonWorldPhoneBoothSection2'),
	}

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self.on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local succubus = self.get_succubus()
	local sweeper = self.get_sweeper()
	local kid_1 = self.get_kid(1)
	local kid_2 = self.get_kid(2)

	if self.cur_part_one_state == self.part_one_state.stun then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_4' })
			return true
		end
	elseif self.cur_part_one_state == self.part_one_state.hide then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_3' })
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.cur_part_two_state == self.part_two_state.garbage_bomb then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sweeper) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sweeper, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_105' })
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.cur_part_three_state == self.part_three_state.success then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_1) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_1, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_5' })
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_2) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_2, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_6' })
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.cur_part_one_state == self.part_one_state.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_7' })
		return true
	elseif self.cur_part_two_state == self.part_two_state.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sweeper) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sweeper, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_77' })
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_1) and
			(self.cur_part_three_state == self.part_three_state.none or self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.progress_part_three) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_1, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_8' })
		return true
	elseif self.cur_part_three_state == self.part_three_state.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_2) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid_2, { key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_9' })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.hang_phone_booth_zone)
			and self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.none and self.is_setting_npc then
		self.is_play_ball = false
		local kid_1 = self.get_kid(1)
		local kid_2 = self.get_kid(2)
		self:play_ball_kid_routine(kid_1, kid_2, kid_1.Position + vector(0.35, 0, 0), kid_2.Position - vector(0.35, 0, 0))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.hang_phone_booth_zone)
			and self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.ending
			and self.cur_part_three_state == self.part_three_state.success then
		-- 엔딩을 본 상태에서 파트3가 성공했었다면 아이들이 남아있으므로 공차기함
		self.is_play_ball = false
		local kid_1 = self.get_kid(1)
		local kid_2 = self.get_kid(2)
		self:play_ball_kid_routine(kid_1, kid_2, kid_1.Position + vector(0.35, 0, 0), kid_2.Position - vector(0.35, 0, 0))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.hang_phone_booth_zone) then
		if self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.none or self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.ending then
			self.is_play_ball = false
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_ball_kid_routine(kid_1, kid_2, start_pos, end_pos)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_ball_kids, self,
			kid_1, kid_2, start_pos, end_pos))
end

function local_class:play_ball_kids(kid_1, kid_2, start_pos, end_pos)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local cur_start_pos = start_pos
	local cur_end_pos = end_pos
	local is_target_first_kid = true
	local duration = 1

	local start_rotation = 0
	local end_rotation = 360

	local soccer_ball = self.get_phone_booth_ball()
	soccer_ball.Transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)

	self.is_play_ball = true
	while self.is_play_ball do
		if not self.can_operate_quest then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(cur_start_pos + vector(0, 0.25, 0))
			if is_target_first_kid then
				character_util.remove_emotion(kid_2)
				character_util.set_emotion(kid_1, { name = 'attack' })
				character_util.set_anim(kid_1, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = kid_1 })
			else
				character_util.remove_emotion(kid_1)
				character_util.set_emotion(kid_2, { name = 'attack' })
				character_util.set_anim(kid_2, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = kid_2 })
			end

			local time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < duration and self.is_play_ball do
				local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, cur_start_pos.x, cur_end_pos.x - cur_start_pos.x, duration)
				local cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_rotation, end_rotation, duration)
				soccer_ball.Position = vector(cur_x, 0, start_pos.z)
				soccer_ball.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_rotation, 0)
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			cur_start_pos = cur_start_pos == start_pos and end_pos or start_pos
			cur_end_pos = cur_end_pos == end_pos and start_pos or end_pos
			is_target_first_kid = is_target_first_kid == false
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key and self.can_operate_quest then
		self.can_operate_quest = false
		-- 폰부스에 Interact 못하게 변경
		local phone_booth = self.get_phone_booth()
		phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		-- npc들 켜져있다면 끄도록
		if self.is_setting_npc then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hide_npc_list, self, e.Fade))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key and not self.can_operate_quest then
		self.can_operate_quest = true
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete
				and self.cur_part_state == self.part_state.none then
			local phone_booth = self.get_phone_booth()
			phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end
		if self.is_setting_npc then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_npc_list, self, e.Fade))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:hide_npc_list(fading)
	if self.cached_npc_active_state ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.cached_npc_active_state = {}

	-- 화면 페이드 중이 아닐 때는 스파인 알파 페이드를 시켜준다.
	local npc_lists = self:get_npc_list()
	if not fading then
		for i = 1, #npc_lists do
			local npc = npc_lists[i]
			local is_active = npc.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			if is_active then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0.5)
			end
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- Npc들을 disabled 시켜준다.
	for i = 1, #npc_lists do
		local npc = npc_lists[i]
		local is_active = npc.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		if is_active then
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		end
		table.insert(self.cached_npc_active_state, is_active)
	end

	if self.cur_part_three_state ~= self.part_three_state.fail then
		local soccer_ball = self.get_phone_booth_ball()
		soccer_ball.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:show_npc_list(fading)
	if self.cached_npc_active_state == nil then
		return
	end

	-- NPC들을 Enabled 시켜준다.
	local npc_lists = self:get_npc_list()
	for i = 1, #npc_lists do
		if self.cached_npc_active_state[i] then
			local duration = fading and 0 or 1
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc_lists[i], 1, duration)
			character_util.set_active_state(npc_lists[i], 'enabled')
		end
	end

	if self.cur_part_three_state ~= self.part_three_state.fail then
		local soccer_ball = self.get_phone_booth_ball()
		soccer_ball.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	self.cached_npc_active_state = nil
end

function local_class:get_npc_list()
	local npc_lists = {}
	local succubus = self.get_succubus()
	table.insert(npc_lists, succubus)
	local sweeper = self.get_sweeper()
	table.insert(npc_lists, sweeper)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local kid = self.get_kid(i)
		table.insert(npc_lists, kid)
	end
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = self.get_android(i)
		table.insert(npc_lists, android)
	end

	return npc_lists
end

function local_class:add_listener_npc()
	local succubus = self.get_succubus()
	character_util.add_listener(succubus, self)
	local sweeper = self.get_sweeper()
	character_util.add_listener(sweeper, self)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local kid = self.get_kid(i)
		character_util.add_listener(kid, self)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_relate_npc()
	local succubus = self.get_succubus()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(succubus, self)
	local sweeper = self.get_sweeper()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(sweeper, self)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local kid = self.get_kid(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(kid, self)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.cached_npc_active_state = nil
	self.is_play_ball = false
	self:remove_relate_npc()

	-- 쓰레기 생성했다면 지워주기
	if self.garbage_item_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.garbage_item_list do
			self.garbage_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.garbage_item_list = nil
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

		self.post_story_section = nil

end

	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'DemonWorldTuringGatlingGunSection1')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	-- 메인 섹션이 15 이하라면 개틀링건 갱이 남아있기 때문에 투명벽을 활성화 시킨다.
	if main_quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 15 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

		for i = 1, 4 do
			local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(i)
			local marker = self.get_invisible_wall_marker(i)
			invisible_wall.Position = marker.position
		end

		local gang = self.get_gatling_gun_gang()
		gang.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(0)
	end
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = false

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	if consumed then
		return consumed
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.gatlinggun_event_zone_name then
				local gang = self.get_gatling_gun_gang()
				character_util.convert_to_monster(gang)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.gatlinggun_event_zone_name then
				local gang = self.get_gatling_gun_gang()
				character_util.convert_to_npc(gang)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local gang = self.get_gatling_gun_gang()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, gang) then
		-- 갱을 죽였다면, 투명벽을 제거한다.
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(i)
			invisible_wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_restaurant', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
		end))
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
		end
		return true
	end
	return false

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.bartender_grid_name) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.prev_stage_bgm_name, state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		end))

		local selected_party = user.Party
		local count = selected_party.Count;

		for i = 1, count - 1, 1 do
			local info = selected_party[i]
			local member_name = CS.Oak.PartyUtil.GeneratePartyName(selected_party, info)
			local member = get_character(member_name)

		end
